interpretation_limit: All windows and remaining candidate templates come from the same 1KX5 entry and nucleosome structure family. Relaxed runs exceed the strict shared-atom and bond-deviation limits. Results do not establish independent-family generalization, environment compatibility, or structural acceptance.
panel_selection_policy: Nine contiguous three-nucleotide windows selected at 16-residue intervals from the 1KX5 chain-I suite register, before panel evaluation; this is a within-entry diagnostic panel, not an independent-family validation set.
